_what: The FDA draft guidance this repository's CREDIBILITY.md maps onto, saved with the provenance a reader needs to check that the page quotes the real document.
title: Considerations for the Use of Artificial Intelligence To Support Regulatory Decision-Making for Drug and Biological Products
status_block_at_fetch: Draft Guidance for Industry and Other Interested Parties
Not for implementation. Contains non-binding recommendations.
_status_note: Read from the landing page at landing_checked_utc, verbatim. The page still carried the draft status on that read; if it ever reads Final, this record is re-fetched rather than edited.
_extraction_note: sha256_txt is the sha256 of the text this exact poppler build produced; another build may lay the page out differently, so the PDF's own sha256 is the pin that matters and the text is the searchable copy beside it.
public_domain: 17 U.S.C. §105 — a work of the United States Government
steps: Step 1: Define the Question of Interest
Step 2: Define the Context of Use for the AI Model
Step 3: Assess the AI Model Risk
Step 4: Develop a Plan to Establish AI Model Credibility Within the Context of Use
Step 6: Document the Results of the Credibility Assessment Plan and Discuss Deviations From the Plan
Step 7: Determine the Adequacy of the AI Model for the Context of Use
_steps_note: The seven step headings of the risk-based credibility assessment framework, extracted from the saved text (never retyped); CREDIBILITY.md uses these strings as its section headings and tests/test_credibility_map.py compares them back to the saved text.
